question: What is the meaning of valuation of reuse in relation to object characteristics (objective registered data related to circularity)?
data_group: object characteristics (objective registered data related to circularity)
description: Valuation of reuse in relation to object characteristics refers to the process of assessing the potential and value of reusing materials or components within a product or system. This valuation is based on the characteristics of the object, which are the objective registered data related to circularity. These characteristics may include material composition, durability, compatibility with other materials, and potential for disassembly and recycling. The valuation helps in determining the feasibility and benefits of reusing materials, contributing to the overall circularity and sustainability of the product or system.
